# Florida Movers Direct

> Free platform connecting Florida residents with licensed, FDACS and FMCSA-verified moving companies. Compare up to 4 free quotes for local, long-distance and commercial moves.

Florida Movers Direct is a Florida-focused lead-matching service. Consumers submit one quote request and receive quotes from up to four licensed moving companies verified against the Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services (FDACS) intrastate registry and the FMCSA interstate registry. The service is free to consumers, always no-obligation, and covers local hourly moves, long-distance interstate moves, commercial and office relocations, storage-in-transit, packing services, piano and specialty moves, and apartment or condo moves throughout Florida.

- [Home — Compare licensed Florida movers](https://floridamoversdirect.com/): Overview, how the quote process works, service list, city coverage, cost tables, and FAQ.
- [Local Movers in Florida — Hourly rates 2026](https://floridamoversdirect.com/local-movers-in-florida/): $95–$150/hr local rate guide, cost drivers, booking timeline.
- [Long Distance Movers in Florida](https://floridamoversdirect.com/long-distance-movers/): Interstate cost ranges, binding vs. non-binding estimates, FMCSA verification, transit times.
- [Storage Solutions in Florida](https://floridamoversdirect.com/storage-solutions/): Climate-controlled and storage-in-transit (SIT) pricing and guidance.
- [Commercial Movers in Florida](https://floridamoversdirect.com/commercial-movers/): Office and business relocation pricing, after-hours logistics.
- [Packing Services in Florida](https://floridamoversdirect.com/packing-services/): Full-pack, fragile-only, and materials pricing.
- [Piano Movers in Florida](https://floridamoversdirect.com/piano-movers/): Specialty upright and grand piano moving.
- [Apartment Movers in Florida](https://floridamoversdirect.com/apartment-movers/): Condo, high-rise, COI, and elevator logistics.
- [Movers in Miami FL — Cost guide](https://floridamoversdirect.com/movers-in-miami/): Miami-specific pricing, condo COIs, Brickell to Kendall.
- [Movers in Tampa FL — Cost guide](https://floridamoversdirect.com/movers-in-tampa/): Tampa pricing, bay crossings, Hyde Park to Wesley Chapel.
- [Movers in Orlando FL — Cost guide](https://floridamoversdirect.com/movers-in-orlando/): Orlando pricing, tourist-corridor traffic, Lake Nona to Winter Park.
- [Movers in Jacksonville FL](https://floridamoversdirect.com/movers-in-jacksonville/): Duval County pricing, military PCS.
- [Movers in Naples FL](https://floridamoversdirect.com/movers-in-naples/): Season-smart scheduling and gated-community access.
- [Movers in Ocala FL](https://floridamoversdirect.com/movers-in-ocala/): Marion County, The Villages routes.
- [Movers in Boca Raton FL](https://floridamoversdirect.com/movers-in-boca-raton/): Condo and 55+ community moving.
